create.account.title: Just one more thing
create.account.subtitle: Your calendar is ready. Create a free account so you can manage it and see everyone's answers.
create.account.reassureSaved: Nothing is lost. Everything you filled in is saved, and the calendar is created the moment you finish signing up.
create.account.reassureParticipants: Your participants never need an account. They open your link, mark the dates they can't make, and they're done.
create.account.reassureEditable: Not quite right? Go back and change any detail before you sign up.
create.basics.title: Start with the basics
create.basics.subtitle: Name your plan and choose who gets to respond.
create.basics.descPlaceholder: Add any details your group should know
create.basics.specificPeopleHint: You name everyone up front. They pick their name from a list.
create.basics.anyoneWithLinkHint: Anyone who opens the link can add themselves.
create.basics.participantsPlaceholder: Type a name and press Enter
create.basics.participantsHint: Type a name and press Enter to add. Click × to remove.
create.basics.switchHint: You can switch this at any point before creating the calendar, and your names are kept either way.
create.dates.title: Set the date window
create.dates.subtitle: Your group will mark the days they can't make inside this window.
create.review.title: Extras and Summary
create.review.subtitle: All optional, and you can change any of this later.
create.review.blockedHint: Dates nobody can pick, shown as unavailable for everyone.
create.review.verificationHint: When enabled, participants must verify their email address before they can submit their unavailable dates.
create.review.verificationTip: Only worth turning on if you are sharing the link somewhere public. For friends, family, or colleagues you already trust, leave this unchecked so they can respond in one click.
create.review.blockedReasonHint: Add an optional reason so your group knows why a date is off the table.
create.signupNotice: One last step after this: create a free account so you can manage the calendar. Your participants will not need one.
create.error.missingDates: Please select both a first and last date
create.error.endBeforeStart: The last date must be after the first date
create.error.noParticipants: Please add at least one participant
create.error.blockedOutOfRange: Blocked dates must fall inside the calendar's date range.
